"}

{"node":"greet.go#Greet","newText":"\treturn \"Hello, \" + name + \"!\"","oldText":"\t// BUG: the expected greeting is \"Hello, <name>!\".\n\treturn \"Hi, \" + name"}
Done. The test was failing because `Greet` returned `"Hi, <name>"` instead of the expected format; I changed it to return `"Hello, " + name + "!"` in greet.go and the suite now passes (`ok greet`).

Now fix the bug in the source so the tests pass. Only change what the task
requires.
